_comment: Hand-made data for the project list. 'featured': the project sites to show first, in this order, as wide Featured cards. 'projects': texts that replace the GitHub values of one project (displayName, description, language). Use repository names. After a change of 'featured' or of a displayName of a featured project, run `npm run og`. See docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.

sre-agent.description: A workshop and a template for an SRE agent on Google Cloud, built with ADK and the Antigravity SDK. The agent reads traces and logs, finds the bottleneck and writes the post-mortem.

okf-skills.description: Agent skills that turn database schemas, file trees and commit history into an Open Knowledge Format (OKF) catalog your agent can read. Each connector is a single binary and works over MCP.

AndroidScreencast.description: View and control your Android device from a PC over ADB, even when the screen is broken. No app needed on the phone.
